about: V287 pediatric development cases. Every case carries the child's age (years in 'age'; infants also say their age in months in the text, as parents write it). Written by the project author from published warning-sign lists for children (NICE NG143 traffic-light table, NHS 'when to call 999 for a child'); starter labels that MUST be reviewed by a clinician (pediatric triage is not decided by the author). Development set.
